comment: The knob at row k and column j sets what input k contributes to output j, X16.cpp:59. Each modulation jack belongs to an output rather than to one knob, and is read one channel per input, X16.cpp:58, so the modulation of a column is monophonic per input. Connections are checked once every 32 samples, X16.cpp:37, so a cable takes up to that long to count. The signal inputs and outputs get no family because they carry whatever is patched in.
